items.title: Re-annotate with a colon marker list
items.text: This sigmoid colon section was annotated with the small-intestine list. Its 4,853 'Paneth cells' have no ITLN2 (0%) and express colonocyte genes (CA2, CFTR, SLC26A2, ADH1B). The 3,089 'BEST4+ enterocytes' have BEST4 in only 10% of cells but GUCA2A, AQP8, CA4 and CEACAM7: they are surface colonocytes. No cell is called Goblet cells. Paneth cells contradict COL-05 and your prior U-1. Draft a colon list (organ_marker_draft('colon') pruned to this panel) and annotate again.

action.request: draft a colon marker list for 167799 with organ_marker_draft(organ='colon'), check and save it, for the user to load and Annotate

check.reason: The small-intestine list mislabels most colon epithelium; the colon list has the missing types and their genes are in the panel
check.evidence: review_markers: Paneth ITLN2 0% of 4,853 cells, ITLN1 92% vs 76% in other epithelium, Goblet cells 0; type_structure(Paneth): a 1,528-cell sub-cluster with CA1 92% and SLC26A3 83%, a 324-cell sub-cluster with CEACAM7 and GUCA2A; 'BEST4+ enterocytes' are GUCA2A 79%, AQP8 75%, CA4 69%; organ_marker_draft('colon') on 167799 keeps Colonocytes (CA1, SLC26A3, CEACAM7, AQP8) and Goblet cells (SPINK4, RETNLB, ITLN1, SPDEF), all in the panel

items.title: Cycling TAs hold stem and goblet cells
items.text: 'Cycling TAs' are 5,304 cells, but only 28% have MKI67 and 93% have RETNLB (a goblet-cell gene). type_structure splits them: one sub-cluster of 745 cells is LGR5+ ASCL2+ SMOC2+ (stem cells, yet 0 cells are called Stem cells), one of 1,251 cells is truly cycling (MKI67, TOP2A), and the rest have no cycling genes. In the colon list, check that Goblet cells and Stem cells get these cells (COL-02, COL-04).

check.reason: Holds, and the colon list uses the same Stem cells definition, so it needs checking after re-annotation
check.evidence: type_structure(Cycling TAs): sub-cluster /1 has 745 cells with LGR5 78%, ASCL2 82%, SMOC2 61%; sub-cluster /2 has 1,251 cells with MKI67 73%, TOP2A 76%; the other sub-clusters have no cycling genes; RETNLB 93% in Cycling TAs vs 36% in other epithelium; Stem cells = 0

items.title: Draw the mucosa so U-1 and COL-01 apply
items.text: No region is drawn on this section, so the region rules (U-1 Paneth exclude, COL-01 epithelium only in the mucosa) do nothing. Drawing the mucosa from epithelial cells would let them act.

action.request: preview_compartment mucosa from Epithelial and propose it as region mucosa

check.reason: A mucosa region would not fix the problem. U-1 would only push the mislabelled colonocytes to their next most likely small-intestine type, and COL-01 has almost nothing to act on (check_plausibility: 17 out-of-place epithelial cells). H1 is the fix.

items.title: Epithelial transcripts spill into stroma
items.text: 59% of non-epithelial cells within 10 um of epithelium carry epithelial markers, falling to 10% beyond 60 um; Telocytes show EPCAM/KRT8 in 54% of cells. This is segmentation spill-over, not mislabelling.

check.reason: Spill-over is real, but it does not change any label: Telocytes keep their F3, BMP5 and POSTN signature and are not called Epithelial. check_registration: max offset 5.2 um, so the cells sit on their nuclei. Nothing for the user to do.
